---
title: "Headings"
subtitle: "Level-two rules are removed"
---

Quarto's article theme draws a line under `h2`. The Kit removes that rule,
including the anchored heading's pseudo-element, and clears the extra padding.
Headings stay Schibsted Grotesk, weight 700, with a tight letter-spacing.
The page title above is the level-one sample.

## Level two has no underline

This heading is the change. There is no bottom border and no padding reserved
for one.

### Level three

Used for a step inside a section.

#### Level four

Used for a smaller break. Levels five and six share this size.

##### Level five

###### Level six

A reading break is an ordinary thematic break, not a heading rule.

That rule is the content divider. It is not attached to the heading.
